correction.statement: In Istio 1.24.0 the istio-base Helm chart templates the Istio CRDs by default, so CRDs can be upgraded with `helm upgrade istio-base` instead of an out-of-band `kubectl apply`; CRD labels change to match other Helm-installed resources, and kubectl apply management continues to work.
